work.abstract_text: For Mertens's Conjecture 3 in Random stable matchings (Section 3.2, equation (15), page 7; arXiv:cond-mat/0509221v2), we prove p_N=Theta(q^N) for the one-dimensional range-two model, simultaneously for both parities, by a six-site completion of open preference words. Here p_N is the probability of a stable partial matching, and q is in (0,1). The same construction proves this conclusion for every fully supported independent identically distributed law on the 24 local rankings. For the uniform law it gives explicit finite-size bounds and convergent enclosures for q. We also give the elementary range-one comparison and triangle-packing bounds, and explain the complete-graph endpoint of Conjecture 5 using Young and Studebaker's corrected asymptotic constant.

work.title: Mertens's range-two stable-matching conjecture and fully supported preference laws
